critical_code_review_comments: All fallback/mock data patterns have been successfully removed from analytics.py, performance.py, and pro_tools.py
Player props now use correct event-level endpoint: /v4/sports/{sport}/events/{eventId}/odds
EV Scanner source is 'live' not 'simulated' - correctly fetches from Odds API
MongoDB caching is properly implemented as fallback when API rate-limited
In-season sports (NBA, NHL, NCAAB) show live data; off-season sports (NFL, MLB) will show unavailable
